0022600159.text: The Detroit Pistons (5-1, first in the Central and first in the East, on a two-game winning streak) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-3, third in the Southeast and eighth in the East, on a two-game losing streak). Out for Detroit are Isaiah Joe and Jalen Duren, while Charlotte is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel, and Kylan Boswell. The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 97-89 win in Detroit on October 28, and they also swept all three meetings in 2025-26.
